_comment: Recall fixture for the high-stakes detector.
positives: real phrasings a worker might type. Each names the trigger it
should produce. The `danger` ones must suppress the answer; the rest
attach a referral to a normal grounded answer.
negatives: questions that must NOT be treated as danger. Seeded from the
corpus's own subject matter, because the detector runs on every turn and
a false danger costs a worker their entire answer.
